newsitem.title: CHINA: China parliament to mull Hong Kong deputies choice.
newsitem.headline: China parliament to mull Hong Kong deputies choice.

text.p: China's National People's Congress will decide temporary rules for the selection of 36 Hong Kong deputies to the parliament during its annual session beginning this weekend, a congress spokesman said on Friday.

Under the draft rules, deputies to represent Hong Kong would be chosen by members of a China-appointed committee responsible for selecting leaders to run the territory after it reverts from British to Chinese rule on July 1, spokesman Zhou Jue said.
Only members of the Beijing-backed Selection Committee with Chinese nationality would be eligible to help choose the Hong Kong deputies, he told a news conference.
The last annual session of the Eighth National People's Congress, which begins on Saturday, is also scheduled to consider a draft defence law and ammendments to the criminal law.
The rules governing the selection of Hong Kong deputies would be temporary and would only apply to the Ninth congress, which begins in March next year, Zhou said.
The parliament is widely considered a rubber-stamp body but has in recent years displayed occasiaonal flashes of independence by showing disagreement over some government appointments and draft laws.
